rv.q: Only the oddly intrusive sensation of the blindfold proves a distraction from the captivating, complex humanity of Beckett’s play.
The actors, evocative of voice, are fiercely committed to their parts in this deceptively straightforward tale...

cn.t: Critics praise this immersive staging of Beckett's 1957 radio play, with audiences experiencing the work blindfolded as a six-strong ensemble creates intimate surround sound that captures the text's captivating humanity.
